title: Tiredness and Low Energy
summary: Rebuild energy with sleep, food and routine
ayurvedicView: Lasting tiredness is linked to depleted ojas, weak digestion or excess Kapha. A steady routine, regular meals, sleep and gentle activity restore energy.
remedies: Regular sleep and waking times, aiming for seven to eight hours
Warm, freshly cooked meals at regular times, with dals and leafy greens for iron
A daily walk, ideally in morning light
Amla or seasonal fruit every day
Ashwagandha in warm milk at night, if a practitioner advises
tips: Notice whether tiredness follows poor sleep, heavy meals or stress
Short breaks during work help more than one long rest
Cut down on caffeine after midday
seeDoctor: Tiredness lasting more than two to three weeks without a clear reason
Tiredness with weight loss, fever, night sweats or breathlessness
Feeling low or hopeless, or losing interest in things
Pale skin, a racing heart or breathlessness on stairs (possible anaemia)

icd11.title: Fatigue
icd11.note: A symptom code; the cause is diagnosed and coded separately.
